infoboxGenderPolicy.reason: No person-sex field was verified. Info/Biografia uses gênero/género for literary genre, and separate gênero_musical aliases for musical genre. Generic gender field matching is forbidden.
infoboxGenderPolicy.futureException: Only permit a field in a specific infobox after its definition explicitly confirms personal sex or gender; never by field spelling alone.

researchLimitations: Portal pages and Portal3 mappings were queried publicly without any Wikimedia account.
Occupation vocabulary is a finite proposed dictionary, not a live multilingual spelling API.
A label must remain an exact explicit job in the principal person infobox.
No personal-sex field was approved, because generic gênero/gender can mean genre or layout metadata.
Additional WikiData lookup must be read-only and conservative, with exact ptwiki subject binding.
No new ptwiki API requests were made after the shared request limit was reported.
